role: Scores a third-party vendor's risk by checking their known infrastructure against already-normalized threat indicators (D-05's output), rather than parsing threat feeds or reinventing matching itself.
behaviorDescription: assessVendor() checks a vendor's known domains/IPs against a supplied list of ThreatIndicator objects (D-05's normalized output) via case-insensitive exact match. Each matched indicator adds a fixed weight to a transparent, explainable risk score capped at 100 — not a black-box model. Records a Decision and signals the swarm when any match is found. Exact matching only — this bot does not attempt fuzzy or related-domain matching, and only reports what it can actually confirm.
hardStops: Never invents a risk score component beyond the transparent per-match weight — no hidden or unexplainable scoring factors
Reuses D-05's ThreatIndicator type directly rather than reimplementing threat-indicator normalization
Never claims a fuzzy or inferred match — only exact, confirmed infrastructure matches are reported
